# Audio state

The object `GET /api/audio/state` answers, the `data` of the `source/state` WebSocket event and the `state` key of `system/initial_state`: one model, the same on every path. Every field is always present — an absent value is `null`, never a missing key. Durations and positions are milliseconds; instants are UTC seconds since the epoch.

The whole state is **contracted**. **Contracted** marks what Milo-Mac or Milo-iOS relies on: a change to it is listed under *API and integration changes* in the release notes. Everything else is **internal** and may change in any release. See [Integration](../integration.md#stability).

| `multiroom_enabled` | boolean |
| `equalizer_effects_enabled` | boolean |

## Details

`details` is the selected source's own content, one shape per source, told apart by `kind`: [`radio`](#radiodetails), [`podcast`](#podcastdetails), [`music_library`](#musiclibrarydetails), [`cd`](#cddetails), [`airplay`](#airplaydetails), [`spotify`](#spotifydetails). It is `null` for the other sources.

### SpotifyRemote

| `device_name` | string |
| `device_type` | string |
| `title` | string \| null |
| `artist` | string \| null |
| `album` | string \| null |
| `artwork` | string \| null |
| `track_uri` | string \| null |
| `duration_ms` | integer \| null |
| `paused` | boolean |
| `position` | [PositionAnchor](#positionanchor) |

### SpotifyJam

The Spotify Jam the signed-in account hosts on Milō: everyone in it can add to the queue and control what plays here.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `members` | [SpotifyJamMember](#spotifyjammember)[] |

### PositionAnchor

The playhead: `ms` at the instant `at`, moving at `rate` while the session plays. position_now = ms + (phase == playing ? (now − at) × 1000 × rate : 0), bounded to [0, duration_ms]. `rate` is 1.0 for every source.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `ms` | integer |
| `at` | number |
| `rate` | number |

## Enumerations

### AudioSource

Available audio sources in the system.

`none`, `spotify`, `bluetooth`, `radio`, `podcast`, `airplay`, `mac`, `cd`, `qobuz`, `tidal`, `music_library`

### ServiceState

Where the selected source's program stands. It says nothing about the session.

`stopped`, `starting`, `running`, `failed`

### RepeatMode

`off`, `context`, `track`

### AvailabilityReason

`no_network`, `no_internet`, `no_account`, `no_drive`, `no_disc`, `reading_disc`, `unreadable_disc`, `ejecting`, `no_storage`, `catalog_unavailable`

### Phase

Where a live session stands.

`loading`, `playing`, `paused`, `connected`
